responsibility: This definition module declares the PIM/Logitech-compatible high-level text I/O interface for GNU Modula-2. It exposes global terminal state such as Done and termCH and procedures for switching current input/output files, reading and writing characters, strings, integers, cardinals, octal and hexadecimal values, and exchanging DynamicStrings tokens, making it the user-facing stream layer above Terminal and Termbase.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the InOut pair: it publishes the user-visible text I/O variables and procedure set, while InOut.mod implements stream switching, parsing, formatting, and Terminal/Termbase integration.
